lines: Hebiko's kodachi cut down the umpteenth High Orc.
And the winner is... Miss Hebiko!!!! Unbelievable, she took them all down!!
A new star is born in Chaos Arena!
Haah... haah... C'mon, what is going on!?
The Orcs had been pretty strong, but they were no match for Hebiko who, despite being a student, had accumulated experience as a Taimanin.
Good thing Hebiko diligently attended the training lessons... And Hebiko's head feels clearer after moving around.
Maybe her blood had started to circulate because of the battle, but Hebiko's memories were becoming clearer little by little.
Going to the Nisha mansion with Hotaru-senpai and getting abducted by Fürst, who had appeared during the mission.
Which means... maybe this is Fürst's hideout?
Honored attendees, we've kept you waiting long enough!!
The crowd cheered especially loudly, interrupting Hebiko's thoughts.
At last, it's the person you've allllll been waiting for!!!
In the area illuminated by the spotlight, a lone woman was walking down the aisle, basking in the raucous cheers.
She approached Hebiko slowly and traced her cheek with her fingernail, looking as if she was going to lick Hebiko's face.
Oh my, aren't you a cute one♪
I am Snake Lady. Nice to meet you, my dear♪
You're called Hebiko-chan, aren't you? Hmhmhm, we're both named after the same animal, perhaps we're linked by fate♪
Ehrm, umm, considering the snake connection... could you please let Hebiko go back home...?
Sorry♪ That's not a proposition I can consider♪
Ugh... knew it. Th-Then at least tell Hebiko! What on earth is this place is?
This is Chaos Arena♪ An arena for female warriors♪
Yes, Hebiko-chan, you're now one of Chaos Arena's exclusive female warriors♪
Eeh!? What, no way! Hebiko refuses!!!
Oh♪ So you would answer my kindness with spite?
K-Kindness...? What kindness is that exactly...?
The kindness of buying you from that bald scoundrel Fürst♪ For a really high price♪
S-So that's how Hebiko got here...
She was finally able to connect the dots between her abduction by Fürst and her current situation.
Did you want to try going to that baldie's place? You surely would have had a really, really bad time there♪
Ah, that's... umm... thank you... very much... ahaha.
She thought she was having a thoroughly bad time right now, but Hebiko swallowed her complaints. There was nothing for her to gain in upsetting Snake Lady.
B-But why did you save Hebiko?
I'm interested in Hebiko-chan's friend♪ So Hebiko-chan is a hostage, or more like bait to lure him out♪
Was it Gaiza or Fuma? Or Shikanosuke... no, no chance of that. Either way, if she was a hostage, then at least she most likely wouldn't be killed for now.
I-In that case... Hebiko will sit down quietly and be a great hostage...!
Look at the spectators♪ At their burning vengeance and desire!
Hebiko looked around at the spectator seats as she was told to, and the enthusiastic guests were shaking their fists and screaming half-crazed.
Smash that stuck up bitch Taimanin to pieces!
Hearing the raw sadism in their yells, Hebiko began to feel nauseated.
The female warriors of Chaos Arena, you see, are a spectacle and also an object to bet on♪
There's plenty of money being wagered on you as well, money that will multiply with each win♪
But if you lose, you will receive a terrible punishment♪ A punishment for making people lose their money♪
While everyone hopes the fighter they bet on will win, they are also expecting those fighters to experience a punishment worse than death when they lose...♪
Win or lose, they can enjoy themselves. Isn't this the greatest show imaginable? Hmhmhm!
A punishment worse than death... but then...
Oh, don't worry, Hebiko-chan. You will have a special guarantee on your life♪ Because you're my hostage♪
Though, via battle or punishment, you may lose a limb or whatnot...♪
Snake Lady patted Hebiko's head as though she were enjoying herself. Her demeanor was completely unguarded, showing not even a shred of wariness.
Rather than throwing herself into a fight that could mean her end at any moment...
What about cutting down Snake Lady right here and escaping?
Hebiko discreetly grabbed her ninjato, but at that moment...
Do you intend to challenge me?
When had she moved? Snake Lady stood behind Hebiko, lifting Hebiko's hair up and licking her ear all over.
I don't mind if we start with a game to decide who is punished, though.
Hebiko had goosebumps all over her body. Snake Lady's lack of vigilance had not been carelessness. It was the confidence that she could take down Hebiko at any time.
Your next opponent will be a bit stronger♪ Go on, hang in there and survive♪
After winning her exhibition match, Miss Hebiko will now attempt the battle as an official female warrior of Chaos Arena!!
Your next opponents will be those sweeties♪
In response to Snake Lady's voice, a beast-like roar could be heard from the entrance to the arena.
Lumbering into the arena came monsters with giant bodies, at least three meters tall.
They were Trolls, a race of demi-humans dwelling in the Devildom. They had low intelligence, but were ferocious and monstrously strong, and above all else, they were said to be tough as nails.
Their favorite food was the flesh of women. They would capture other species indiscriminately and eat them alive.
Didn't a teacher say... if you're caught by one, suicide is recommended. Haha, good thing Hebiko is always studiously attending lessons...
...Not the time to be joking around! Hebiko has got to get serious right from the start...
Hebiko prepared herself for the worst and unleashed the power of "Beastified Taimanin."
It's alright... Hebiko will get through this!
Now then! Miss Hebiko's real fight begins!
